title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 051 ]

blocks.text: The way to wealth, if you desire it, is as plain as the way to market. It depends chiefly on two words, diligence and thrift ; that is, waste neither time nor money, but make the best use of both. Without diligence and thrift nothing will happen, and with them everything. He who gets all he can honestly, and saves all he gets will certainly obtain his goal.

readingSentences.english: The way to wealth, if you desire it, is as plain as the way to market.
readingSentences.korean: 만약 당신이 부를 원한다면, 부에 이르는 길은 시장으로 가는 길만큼이나 명백하다.

readingSentences.english: It depends chiefly on two words, diligence and thrift ; that is, waste neither time nor money, but make the best use of both.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 주로 두 단어, 즉 '근면'과 '절약'에 달려 있다; 다시 말해 시간도 돈도 낭비하지 말고 둘 다 최대한으로 활용하라는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Without diligence and thrift nothing will happen, and with them everything.
readingSentences.korean: 근면과 절약이 없다면 아무것도 이루어지지 않지만, 그것들이 있다면 모든 것이 가능하다.

readingSentences.english: He who gets all he can honestly, and saves all he gets will certainly obtain his goal.
readingSentences.korean: 정직하게 얻을 수 있는 모든 것을 얻고, 얻은 모든 것을 저축하는 사람은 반드시 자신의 목표를 달성할 것이다.
